notFound.label: Error 404
notFound.title: Page not found
notFound.text: Either it moved, or the address has a typo. Nothing's lost: the blog is open, and everything on it is free.
notFound.truthBody: An address changes when a piece of content is renamed. Old ones get redirected when I know about them — this one slipped through, and I'd rather tell you than let you guess.

forbidden.label: Error 403
forbidden.title: Access denied
forbidden.truthBody: A route guard is client code: it hides, it doesn't forbid. The real separation lives in the database rules — this page only says what they already refused.
forbidden.textAfter: . It reaches exactly five screens, and this isn't one of them.
